clinicalIntro: Review the document and confirmed extraction. Document review and result validation are independent operations.
clinicalDemo: Clinical operations require an authorized API session and documents from the configured environment.
clinicalDiscard: A draft or operation is pending. Discard local state and load the new context? This does not cancel requests already received by the server.
clinicalOtherDraft: Another document is open in the clinical workspace.
clinicalDone: The server recorded the operation. Displayed states come from its response.
clinicalMemory: Draft in RAM: notes and corrections are NOT saved on the server. Navigation preserves the draft; closing or reloading loses it.
clinicalUnavailable: The server does not allow reading this extraction. It may await patient confirmation or have a state hidden from clinicians. Document review is independent.
clinicalAttention: This field requires attention according to server flags or validation.
clinicalReviewHelp: Record an immutable review of the verified file. This does not validate extraction. The private note is not returned by document reads.
clinicalValidationHelp: Only patient-confirmed extractions are eligible. Validation may correct markers; rejection invalidates active markers. The clinical note is separate from the review note.
clinicalExplicit: Check patient, document and changes before sending. Identity and server state will be revalidated. No definitive validation is shown without a response.
clinicalAction_review: The document review will be recorded.
clinicalAction_validated: The extraction will be validated with these corrections.
clinicalAction_rejected: The extraction will be rejected and its active markers invalidated.
clinicalInvalid: Complete corrected values and units and check note limits.
clinicalRejectEdits: Rejection does not apply corrections. Revert value and unit edits before preparing rejection.
clinicalPaused: Operation interrupted. The draft remains in memory; verify session and connection.
clinicalConflict: Server state changed. This operation was not sent. Compare your draft before loading current state.
clinicalUncertain: A definitive outcome cannot be attributed to this request. Current state was read without repeating validation. Check the outcome before starting another operation.
clinicalPatientMismatch: The document does not belong to the selected patient.
DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: The server blocks review: document not ready or review already recorded and immutable.
NOT_CONFIRMED: The extraction is no longer confirmed or another clinician processed it.
INVALID_MARKER_CORRECTIONS: The server rejected corrections. Check marker errors; no changes were applied.
MARKER_NOT_IN_EXAM: This marker is not active in the document.
reviewDuplicate: The proposal repeats a marker code. Safe confirmation is blocked; request document review.
reviewUploadFailed: File processing failed. No proposal is available to confirm.
reviewUploadRejected: The server rejected the file. Confirmation is blocked.
reviewUploadDeleted: The document was removed and cannot be confirmed.
UNIT_NOT_SUPPORTED: Unit not supported by the catalog.
VALUE_INVALID_FORMAT: The value must be a valid number.
VALUE_IMPLAUSIBLE: The server rejected the value. Compare with the document.
RETRYABLE_CONFLICT: Write conflict. Verify and retry the same operation.
reviewIntro: Compare these data with your document. Correct reading errors before confirming.
reviewDemo: Review requires a real extraction and authorized API session. Demo does not confirm data.
reviewOtherDraft: Another document has a draft in memory.
reviewResetWarning: Local corrections in this draft will be lost. Load the current server proposal?
reviewDone: Confirmation recorded by the server. This is separate from clinical validation.
reviewMemory: Draft in memory: changes are NOT saved on the server. Navigation retains the draft; closing or reloading loses it.
reviewOffline: No verified connection. Keep editing your draft; confirmations will not be sent automatically.
reviewMissing: Some dates were not provided by the extraction.
reviewReadOnly: This marker requires specialist review and cannot be edited in this form.
reviewIncomplete: Incomplete data or pending validation. Check the original document.
reviewIdentity: I checked that this document belongs to me.
reviewLowAck: I reviewed marker {{code}}, flagged for low confidence.
reviewNoDiagnosis: This view transcribes data; it does not diagnose or interpret results.
reviewExplicit: I confirm I reviewed the document, values and units. Without changes, the original proposal will be confirmed.
reviewSending: Verifying and sending. Wait for the server response.
reviewPermission: Confirmation requires a verified patient session with extractions:confirm permission.
reviewInvalid: Check dates and complete values and units for corrections.
reviewAcknowledgments: Complete identity and low confidence acknowledgments.
reviewPaused: Operation interrupted. Your draft is retained; check connectivity before retrying.
reviewConflict: The server proposal changed. These corrections were not sent. Compare your draft before loading the current version.
reviewServerError: The server could not complete the request. Check your data and try again.
reviewDocumentUnavailable: The document is not yet available for review.
reviewHttp0: Confirmation was not received. Check connectivity and retry explicitly.
reviewHttp403: You are not authorized for this operation.
reviewHttp404: The document or extraction is no longer available.
reviewHttp422: The server rejected these data. Correct fields before reviewing again.
reviewHttp429: Server rate limit. Wait before retrying.
reviewHttp500: Uncertain server response. Retry to verify the same operation.
reviewHttp503: Service unavailable. The operation is retained for later verification.
EXTRACTION_NOT_READY: Extraction is not ready. Check again later.
INVALID_CLINICAL_DATE: The server rejected a clinical date. Review document dates.
EXTRACTION_SUPERSEDED: This extraction was replaced. Load the current proposal.
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This operation differs from the previous request. Automatic resend is blocked.
INVALID_EXTRACTION_STATE: The proposal no longer allows this confirmation.
IDENTITY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Confirm that the document belongs to you.
INVALID_MARKER_EDIT: This marker does not allow that correction.
REFERENCE_UNIT_MISMATCH: Reference unit mismatch. Check the document unit.
UNKNOWN_MARKER: Marker not recognized by the catalog.
UNSUPPORTED_UNIT: Unit not supported by the catalog.
INVALID_VALUE: Value not accepted by the catalog.
REQUEST_TIMEOUT: Request timed out. Verify the outcome before retrying.
NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE: Connection interrupted. Your draft remains in memory.
INVALID_RESPONSE: Invalid response. Confirmation cannot be verified.
session_unverified: Identity temporarily unverified; current session data remains in memory
uploadPreparation: How your document will be protected
uploadSubtitle: Send your document for verification. Transfer and processing are separate steps.
uploadFormats: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC. Maximum 20 MiB. The server checks the actual content.
uploadConsent: I consent to AI processing of this document
uploadConsentHelp: Optional. File verification is separate from clinical interpretation or validation.
uploadDemoBlocked: Demo mode: you can inspect the form, but files are not sent. Uploads require authorized identity and storage.
uploadDiscardConfirm: The file and details held in memory will be lost. Documents or upload sessions already created on the server will not be deleted. Continue?
uploadInMemory: This tab holds an upload in memory.
uploadProgressUnknown: Transfer in progress; percentage is not yet available.
uploadCheck_not_applicable: Not required for this synthetic PDF
uploadMayRemoveOriginal: The server confirmed that this upload no longer requires your original copy. Keep any backups you need.
uploadKeepOriginal: Keep the original file: the server has not authorized discarding it.
uploadPrivacyTitle: Your document stays under your control
uploadMemoryHelp: The file and form are held only in memory while this tab remains open. After reloading or closing, you may need to select the file again. Check your exams before starting another upload to avoid duplicates.
uploadNoResumePromise: After a connection failure, explicitly retry once your session is revalidated. Transfer may restart from the beginning; there is no persistent queue or multipart resume.
uploadNoAutomaticDelete: WellQ does not delete files from your device. Cancel stops the local operation; data already received by the server may continue processing.
uploadInvalidFile: Use a safe filename and matching file extension and type: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC.
uploadInvalidSize: Select a non-empty file up to 20 MiB.
uploadInvalidMetadata: Check the document title, date and exam details.
uploadPutFailed: Storage did not confirm the transfer. The file is retained for an explicit retry.
uploadInvalidStorage: The received storage authorization is invalid. The document will not be sent using that configuration.
uploadExpiredUrl: Temporary authorization expired. Retry to request a new one.
uploadConnectionRequired: Continue with a connection, a revalidated patient session, and read/upload permissions.
uploadRetryLater: The server requested a delay before retrying. The operation is retained in memory.
uploadNotConfirmed: The server has not confirmed the upload. Keep the original and continue once connected.
uploadUnknownError: This step could not complete. The file is retained in this tab for inspection or retry.
error_413: The file exceeds the server's permitted size.
uploadPhase_selected: File selected. Nothing has been sent yet.
uploadPhase_hashing: Validating metadata and calculating the file's SHA-256 digest.
uploadPhase_uploading: Transferring the document to private storage.
uploadPhase_transferred: Storage confirmed transfer. Server verification is still pending.
uploadPhase_completing: Confirming the upload to request verification.
uploadPhase_processing: Processing is pending or in progress. See the checks reported by the server.
uploadPhase_available: Document verified and available. Clinical review is a separate step.
uploadPhase_rejected: The server rejected the document. Keep the original and inspect the file.
uploadPhase_failed: Processing failed. Keep the original; team support may be needed.
uploadPhase_deleted: The server deleted the document. This operation will not send it again.
uploadPhase_paused: Operation interrupted. File retained in memory; continue once your session and connection are available.
uploadPhase_cancelled: Local operation cancelled. The file remains in memory and you can explicitly continue.
uploadPhase_poll-limit: Automatic checks stopped at their limit. The server may still be processing.
uploadPhase_error: This step could not complete. No successful upload is claimed.
uploadExtraction_extraction_failed: Extraction failed; the file may be verified
uploadStepHash: Select the file and check its integrity.
uploadStepInitiate: Review the exam details and your consent.
uploadStepTransfer: Send the document privately using temporary authorization.
uploadStepVerify: Complete and check server status before permitting local deletion.
uploadPreparationPending: Uploads are not enabled yet. No document has been selected, sent, or synchronized.
offlineHelp: The interface and previously received data remain in memory during this session. Reading or sending new information requires a connection. No clinical operation queue is enabled.
demoOfflineHelp: You can continue exploring synthetic documents. The installed shell can reopen the demonstration offline; it does not replace the mobile app.
cachedInMemory: Previously received information from this session, not refreshed. No new operation has been confirmed and no persistent clinical copy has been stored.
draftInMemory: This identifier has not been queried yet. It stays in memory only; reloading or signing out discards it.
updateReady: A portal update is ready. Your in-memory work will not be reloaded automatically.
updateConfirm: Updating reloads the portal and discards unsent fields. Continue?
demoClinicsUnavailable: Demo clinics could not be loaded. Check the API connection.
session_error: The provider operation failed; access remains closed
error_400: The server could not accept this request.
error_500: The server encountered an issue. The operation has not been confirmed.
error_timeout: The request timed out. Its outcome has not been confirmed.
accessProfessionalIntro: Your workspace to review exams and support your patients' care.
accessPatientIntro: Access your documents and continue following your exams.
accessDelegatedHelp: Continue with your organization's identity service. WellQ does not ask for your password on this screen.
accessProviderHelp: Access depends on the authorized identity service. If it is not connected yet, you cannot sign in from this portal.
accessOffline: A connection to the API is needed to continue. You can check it in the status bar.
accessScope: Your identity and permissions determine which information you can access.
demoNotice: Demonstration environment · All documents are synthetic. No real clinical data.
sessionHelp: This backend verifies tokens from an external provider. Identity integration is not configured in this portal yet.
noGrant: Your session does not have the clinical:read permission.
forbidden: This view is unavailable for your role.
overviewSubtitle: Organized documents, clear statuses, and human review at every step.
clinicalSubtitle: Explore an authorized patient's exams and prepare their clinical review.
pdfUnavailable: Could not open the PDF. Check your connection and try again.
patientIdHelp: Enter the identifier provided by your platform. The server verifies the clinical relationship.
patientRequired: Enter an identifier of 1 to 200 characters without spaces.
noPatient: Select a patient to view their exams.
examSubtitle: Explore documents and their processing status.
reviewCount: Ready for review on this page
pageOnly: Counts refer to the loaded page, not the complete history.
uploadPending: The upload form is available to patients. Sending documents requires authorized identity and storage. The offline queue belongs to the Flutter client.
clinicalPendingBody: Confirmation, validation, history and PDF use backend routes with an authorized session. Production deployment requires approved external providers. This portal does not calculate scores or diagnoses.
patientPendingBody: Proposal confirmation will become available when its flow is integrated. Upload and clinical review are separate steps. Patients do not receive scores or clinical interpretation.
emptyBody: No exams were found for this patient with the selected filters.
errorTitle: We could not complete the request
offlineBody: Check your connection. This web portal does not store clinical documents for offline use.
error_0: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and the API URL.
error_401: Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again through your identity provider.
error_403: The server denied access. Check permissions and the patient relationship.
error_409: The state changed or a conflict occurred. Refresh before trying again.
error_422: The server rejected the submitted parameters.
error_429: The request limit was reached. Wait before trying again.
error_503: A required service is unavailable. Try again later.
error_502: The response does not match the expected contract.
error_unknown: The request failed. Data has not been replaced with a demonstration.
detailNotice: File status and clinical review are different processes. A document ready for review does not imply confirmed or validated results.
catalogSubtitle: Explore the catalog published by the backend. Availability does not establish clinical validation.
serverAuthority: Permissions and the clinical relationship are verified by the server.
configurationError: The portal could not start. Check your local configuration.
CLINICAL_VERSION_CONFLICT: Server state changed. This operation was not sent. Compare your draft before loading current state.
CLINICAL_VERSION_REQUIRED: Server state changed. This operation was not sent. Compare your draft before loading current state.
recordsIntro: Confirmed measurements and reports provided by the clinical API. Select an authorized patient.
recordsDemo: History, scores and PDF reports require an authorized API session. No clinical results are simulated here.
recordsInvalidDates: The start date must not be after the end date.
recordsCatalogHelp: The catalog lists supported markers, not a patient inventory. The API may return an empty series.
recordsNoMeasurements: No confirmed measurements were returned for this selection.
recordsChartHelp: Recorded measurements only. Units are separated; missing values break the line. Use the table for full details.
recordsChartKeys: Use left and right arrow keys to inspect measurements.
recordsOnePoint: A single measurement is available. A trend cannot be established.
recordsNoNumeric: There are no dated numeric measurements with a known unit to plot.
recordsVerifiedBand: Constant reference range with an identified source
recordsReferencePerPoint: Reference ranges vary or lack a verified source. Consult each measurement in the table.
recordsMeasurementTable: Measurements returned by the API, in chronological order
recordsUnapproved: The catalog is not clinically approved. Numeric scores are withheld.
recordsNoScore: No current publishable score is available.
recordsTechnicalCoverage: Technical coverage of this catalog version
recordsNotDiagnosis: Charts and scores summarize available measurements and do not constitute a diagnosis.
recordsMode_aggregate: Latest measurements in the selected window
recordsPrivateNotes: This read contract does not expose private review notes. No browser-generated medical interpretation is added.
recordsExportHelp: Generate the PDF explicitly, then download it. Links are private, temporary and remain only in memory. Changing source data requires a new consultation.
recordsExportPermission: Export requires an online verified clinician session, reports:export and the report_export capability.
recordsRetryExport: Retry the same export / renew link
recordsExport_generating: Checking identity and current data; requesting the server PDF.
recordsExport_ready: The server PDF is ready to download.
recordsExport_pending: The export or its download link is still pending. Wait and retry explicitly.
recordsExport_uncertain: The request outcome is uncertain. A manual retry retains the same idempotency key.
recordsExport_downloading: Verifying the source and PDF bytes.
recordsExport_downloaded: PDF verified and handed to the browser for saving.
recordsExport_stale: The source changed. Refresh clinical data before a new export.
recordsExport_failed: The attempt failed. Refresh clinical data before requesting another export.
recordsExportError: The export could not be completed. Check access, connection or storage and retry explicitly.
recordsExportUncertain: The operation did not complete reliably; no automatic retry was sent.
recordsSignerPending: The server retained the PDF, but storage could not issue a download link.
recordsAccessDenied: Clinical access is no longer available
recordsAccessHelp: Private records and export links were cleared. Revalidate your identity and clinical relationship before returning.
recordsReason_no_confirmed_exams: The API reports no confirmed examinations.
EXPORT_SOURCE_CHANGED: The report source changed. Refresh clinical data and explicitly request a new PDF.
EXPORT_VERSION_REQUIRED: Refresh the report before requesting a PDF with its current version.
EXPORT_IN_PROGRESS: The server is still processing this attempt. Wait and explicitly retry the same request.
EXPORT_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED: This attempt expired. Refresh the report and explicitly request a new PDF.
EXPORT_ATTEMPT_FAILED: This attempt failed. Refresh the report before requesting a new PDF.
PDF_GENERATION_FAILED: The PDF could not be built. Refresh the report before starting another attempt.
STORAGE_ERROR: Storage could not confirm the PDF upload. Refresh the report and explicitly request a new export.
PDF_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: The server PDF engine is unavailable.
DOWNLOAD_EXPIRED: The private link expired or was refused. Renew it explicitly.
DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The PDF download failed its transport, size or integrity checks.
RECORD_PATIENT_MISMATCH: The response does not match the authorized patient. Access was blocked.
recordsExportProductionBlocked: PDF export is not enabled for production use. You can read the clinical report on screen.
recordsExportTestOnly: Export is available only for authorized testing. The PDF is a dated snapshot; it does not certify continuous currency.
